personalInfo.name: Varshith Reddy Raavi
personalInfo.headline: Data Scientist | AI/ML Engineer | MLOps Engineer
personalInfo.bio: Data Scientist with hands-on experience delivering enterprise-grade solutions across Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance domains. Strong background in Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and Generative AI workflows deployed on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Proven ability to translate business problems into scalable data, ML, and AI-driven solutions using modern cloud-native tooling.

experiences.title: Graduate Research Assistant | NLP Researcher
experiences.description: MoodComposer: AI-Powered Song Generation Platform | GPT-2, Bark, MusicGen
highlights: Developed an AI-powered music generation platform capable of creating emotionally aligned songs through real-time sentiment analysis and natural language processing techniques.
Fine-tuned GPT-2 on the GeniusLyrics dataset to generate context-aware and genre-specific lyrics, achieving approximately 92% emotion alignment with user intent.
Integrated Bark and MusicGen models for end-to-end audio synthesis with phoneme-aware vocal generation, reducing inference latency by 30%.
Designed scalable inference workflows for lyric generation, sentiment classification, and audio rendering to support interactive user experiences.

experiences.title: Graduate Research Assistant | MLSecOps
experiences.description: Generative jailbreak prompts for large language models
highlights: Engineered an adversarial prompt generation framework leveraging reinforcement learning using PPO and evolutionary search algorithms to evaluate LLM robustness.
Evaluated prompt attacks against multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including GPT-4, Claude, and LLaMA models, achieving an attack success rate exceeding 80% in controlled sandbox environments.
Developed a multi-objective evaluation framework measuring attack success rate, stealthiness, and reproducibility to benchmark prompt effectiveness.
Proposed mitigation strategies and safety mechanisms for improving LLM robustness against adversarial prompt injection attacks.

experiences.title: Associate Data Scientist
experiences.description: GangaSoft: E-Commerce Sales & Demand Analytics Platform
highlights: Analyzed large-scale retail transaction and customer data to identify sales trends, product performance, and regional demand patterns across 10M+ point-of-sale transactions.
Built scalable data pipelines for ingesting, cleaning, and transforming 15M+ daily records from sales, inventory, and pricing systems.
Performed statistical analysis and exploratory data analysis to uncover seasonality, promotion impact, and customer purchasing behavior, supporting merchandising and pricing decisions.
Designed optimized analytical models and queries in BigQuery to compute KPIs such as revenue, basket size, and sell-through rates, reducing report generation time by ~30%.
Developed interactive dashboards and reports to track sales performance and inventory health across 1,000+ retail locations.
Optimized ETL workflows using SQL and Python, improving pipeline performance and reducing data latency for downstream analytics.

projects.title: AI-Powered Network Traffic Anomaly Detection with Explainability
projects.description: Built a network intrusion detection system designed to be both highly accurate and interpretable enough for security analysts to trust and act on.
highlights: Designed 3-layer hybrid detection model (VAE + LSTM + XGBoost) on UNSW-NB15 dataset, achieving 93.6% precision and 35% fewer false positives vs. baseline.
Integrated SHAP explainability for per-prediction feature attribution; deployed via FastAPI REST endpoint in a Dockerized backend.

projects.title: Containerized Database Automation on Kubernetes
projects.description: Eliminated manual database operations overhead by building a fully self-healing, GitOps-driven infrastructure for stateful workloads on Kubernetes.
highlights: Built self-healing PostgreSQL/MongoDB orchestration on Kubernetes using Helm and GitOps practices.
Instrumented Prometheus/Grafana monitoring; provisioned infrastructure-as-code with Terraform for repeatable deployments.

projects.title: Multilingual Text-to-Image Generator with Stable Diffusion
projects.description: Made text-to-image generation accessible to non-English speakers by removing the English-only bottleneck common to most diffusion-based image models.
highlights: Developed multilingual visual-prompt interpreter using Stable Diffusion + XLM-R embeddings supporting 20+ languages; served via FastAPI with ONNX/CUDA inference (50% speed boost).
Optimized inference using ONNX and CUDA acceleration to make the system practical and responsive for real-world, real-time use.
